Artists and Fans Pay Tribute to Duran Duran Guitarist Andy Taylor

Fans and fellow artists are paying tribute to Andy Taylor, the guitarist of Duran Duran and a Rock & Roll Hall of Fame inductee, after his death this week at age 65. Taylor died Monday after a yearslong battle with stage 4 metastatic prostate cancer.
